# Jawad Boulmal — Full Stack Developer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio and blog of Jawad Boulmal, a Full Stack Developer based in Casablanca, Morocco. Specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, React, and Next.js.

## About

Jawad Boulmal is a Full Stack Developer passionate about building scalable architectures and solving complex backend challenges. Currently working at DabaDoc and completing advanced training at YouCode - UM6P (Mohammed VI Polytechnic University). Open to new opportunities.

## Skills

- **Backend:** Java, Spring Boot, NestJS, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Laravel, PHP
- **Frontend:** Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Mobile:** Flutter
- **Infrastructure:** Docker, AWS, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, REST API, Microservices
- **Tools:** Git, GitHub
